description:
"#Mexico is not and will not be a colony or protectorate of any foreign country," Mexican President Claudia #Sheinbaum posted on social media on Monday, reaffirming her country's sovereignty.
The statement came after U.S. President Donald #Trump posted a map on his social media platform Truth Social showing Mexico, the Caribbean, #Canada, as well as several other countries and territories, covered by the stars and stripes of the U.S. flag.
title: Mexican president reaffirms sovereignty after provocative AI-generated U.S. map

author: New China TV
description:
A village with fewer than 300 registered villagers gets 11 million visitors a year. Guess where else gets that many visitors? The Terracotta Warriors, one of the world's greatest archaeological sites.
A tiny village, matching the Terracotta Warriors. No world-class landmarks. Just steaming bowls of tofu pudding, hand-pulled noodles, shadow puppetry, Qin Opera, and a way of life that many city people thought had disappeared. (recorded)
title: How a small village draws as many visitors as the Terracotta Warriors?
